job.job_description:
We are looking for a Generative AI Developer with strong hands-on experience in LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and cloud-based AI solutions. The candidate will design, develop, and deploy scalable AI applications using modern frameworks, APIs, and DevOps practices.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions using LLMs and RAG architectures
Build scalable RESTful APIs using FastAPI
Integrate AI applications with Azure Cloud services ensuring security and scalability
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments
Implement Docker-based containerization for application delivery
Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate requirements into AI solutions
Optimize data pipelines and queries using SQL
Apply DevOps best practices for automation, monitoring, and continuous improvement
Required Skills & Qualifications
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
Hands-on experience with FastAPI
Practical knowledge of LLMs, RAG, and prompt engineering
Experience with Azure Cloud (AI services, Storage, Compute)
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Docker
Proficiency with Git and version control workflows
Strong problem-solving and system design skills
Preferred Skills
Experience with MLOps and model lifecycle management
Familiarity with Vector Databases and Semantic Search
Knowledge of API security standards (OAuth, JWT)
Exposure to monitoring and performance optimization for AI systems
